en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Not one of you should swallow what he picks teeth with, for the pus can happen from it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not take light what you use as a toothpick, it can cause a boil in one’s belly (that may cause one’s death).”’
